description: Create a social post as a DRAFT — nothing is published. Give it a working title, the main text, optional hashtags, the channels (each may carry its own text), and images: public https image links (Obriym stores its own copy), files the person attached in ChatGPT (the `files` field, filled by ChatGPT), links returned by create_image_upload for local files, and/or a catalog product whose photos are attached and whose sell-out later marks the live Telegram and Threads post as sold. Each channel's text, with hashtags, must fit that channel's limit (list_content_channels). Returns the post id and warnings — a channel that is not ready, Instagram without an image — to relay to the person. Not idempotent: each call creates a new draft. Then use schedule_content_post or publish_content_post. Echoes the workspace.

channels.description: Where the post goes — one entry per channel, each at most once. Every channel publishes the main text unless its entry carries its own text.

channel.description: A social channel: telegram (the bound Telegram channel), instagram, facebook (the Facebook page), linkedin or threads. Use only channels list_content_channels reports as ready.

text.description: Text written for THIS network only. Omit it to publish the post's main text. It must fit the channel's maxTextLength from list_content_channels together with the hashtags (Threads allows 500 characters, Instagram 2200).

files.description: Image files the person attached in ChatGPT. ChatGPT fills this field itself; any other client leaves it out and passes image links instead (or uploads files with create_image_upload).

download_url.description: Temporary link ChatGPT gives to the attached file.

file_id.description: ChatGPT's id of the attached file.

format.description: post = a regular feed post; story = an Instagram/Facebook story, which needs an image. Defaults to post.

hashtags.description: Hashtags without the "#" sign, at most 30. They are appended to every channel's text as their own line.

imageUrls.description: Images to attach, as public https links to JPEG, PNG or WebP files of at most 2 MB each. Obriym downloads and keeps its own copy, so the link only has to work now. Threads accepts JPEG and PNG only.

items.description: A public https link to the image file itself.

productId.description: A catalog product this post advertises (id from search_products). Links the post to the product, so when it sells out Obriym marks the live Telegram and Threads post as sold, and lets productPhotos attach the product's photos.

productPhotos.description: With productId: attach the product's own photos after any imageUrls, up to 10 images in total. Set false to post without them.

text.description: The post's main text, in the language the audience reads. Plain text: no markdown, links are written out in full. Never invent a price, discount, stock level or date — state only facts the user or the CRM gave you.

title.description: An internal working title shown in Obriym's Publications list, e.g. "Monday — new arrivals". Never published.
